Extracts response metadata from HTTP headers (etag, server, content-language)

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.responseMeta()?.etag())
debugPrint(result.responseMeta()?.lastModified())
debugPrint(result.responseMeta()?.server())
debugPrint(result.responseMeta()?.contentLanguage())
```
